description: Sea Ice for Walrus Outlook (SIWO) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by National Weather Service | Alaska Region; Eskimo Walrus Commission; Arctic Research Consortium of the United States. This site is for Alaska Native subsistence hunters, coastal communities, and others interested in sea ice and walrus. It promotes hunter safety, food security, and preservation of cultural heritage. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
